# pcd_host_config_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a host configuration to a host (the network-interface/label config a host uses).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_host_config" "example" {
  name           = "hc-single-nic"
  mgmt_interface = "enp1s0"
  network_labels = { physnet1 = "enp1s0" }
}

resource "pcd_host_config_assignment" "example" {
  host_id        = "04575315-80ce-4617-9b96-6611d00c9942"
  host_config_id = pcd_host_config.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_config_id` (String) The host configuration to assign. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `host_id` (String) The host to assign the config to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite `<host_id>/<host_config_id>` ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_host_config_assignment.example <host_id>/<host_config_id>
```
